assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the controlled creation clock returns 1700000000000 milliseconds
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-079"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-079.js"
6. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create New Import Map" on the Import Map administration page

steps.title: Set fixed time "Wed Nov 15 2023 06:13:20 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
Set fixed time "Thu Oct 22 2026 14:47:33 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 7. Then the dialog titled "new ID: 1700000000000" is visible on the Import Map administration page
8. When the controlled database event removes Import Map 201 before submission
9. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Name" with "container-079" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
10. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Path" with "https://fixture.example/case-079.js" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
11. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Create" in dialog "new ID: 1700000000000"
12. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the captured rejection response message
